end.summary:
Practised distinguishing points, line segments, lines and rays by endpoints and arrows.
Named segments, lines and rays using letters; identified that ray AB starts at A.
Counted connecting segments for 3, 4 and 5 points: 3, 6 and 10.
Aryan initially treated a ray as having two endpoints; the misconception remained noted.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised using endpoints, arrows and starting letters to identify geometric figures. They used the point-pair method to count all joining segments and correctly named several rays, including their starting points. The two-endpoint mix-up for a ray was seen and was not marked as corrected after its last occurrence. At home, ask Aryan to draw one segment, line and ray and label their endpoints or arrows.
